heading: {kind, select, roles {Roles you own} groups {Groups you own} service-accounts {Service accounts you own} other {Applications you own}}
sub: Everything of this kind whose owners name you, or a group you are in. An owner answers for a resource; it grants nothing. To change one, ask an administrator.
none: You own no {kind, select, roles {role} groups {group} service-accounts {service account} other {application}}.
